TelemetryRun.title: TelemetryRun
TelemetryRun.description: Hexagon v73 HTP NPU utilization, thermal throttling, GPU batch tokenizer, and OpenXML document cloning telemetry run.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID who recorded the telemetry run.

deviceModel.description: Android device manufacturer and model string.

socBadge.description: Detected SoC hardware badge (e.g. Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 Hexagon v73 HTP).

executionProvider.description: Active ONNX Runtime execution provider mode.

promptTokens.description: Number of prompt tokens encoded by the GPU batch tokenizer.

generatedTokens.description: Number of tokens generated by the NPU decoder.

batchTokenizeMs.description: Batch BPE tokenization latency in milliseconds.

gpuPrefetchMs.description: Async GPU Q4F16 embedding prefetch latency in milliseconds.

prefillTokPerSec.description: 32-token chunked NPU prefill throughput in tokens per second.

decodeTokPerSec.description: Autoregressive NPU decode throughput in tokens per second.

avgNpuStepMs.description: Average NPU decoder step latency in milliseconds.

peakNpuUtilPercent.description: Peak Hexagon v73 HTP NPU duty cycle percentage (0..100).

isThermalThrottling.description: Whether SoC thermal throttling was active during the run.

nativeHeapMb.description: Allocated native ONNX C++ heap in megabytes.

inspectDurationMs.description: Chat Sandbox inspect_template execution time in milliseconds.

cloneDurationMs.description: Chat Sandbox clone_document OpenXML reconstruction time in milliseconds.

compactedTurns.description: Number of historical turns compacted by the internal thought compactor.

status.description: Outcome status of the task run (e.g., CLONED_DOCX_OK, COMPLETED, ERROR).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the telemetry run was written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the telemetry run was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/telemetry_runs/{runId}.description: User-scoped Cloud Firestore Telemetry Sink storing real-device Hexagon v73 HTP NPU and thermal telemetry runs.
